description: Fraunhofer Harmonic Tool: Harmonic and Interharmonic Group Model based on IEC 61000-4-7. (FHT-Model) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC); Fraunhofer ISE. Deep Analysis of Power quality for single generation units and multiple decentralized and sychronized measurement units. Emulation of Summation effects and parameters identification for stability prediction. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: 200ms - 10 min. Software: Matlab; compatibility to Dewesoft. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
